memory_candidates.content: In this repo's typst/Lean tree, FrameClass is a partial order (Base < Dense/ZTime < RTime, Dense <= RTime, ZTime incomparable with both Dense and RTime). A frame-class extension X that sits above Dense in this order 'extends the Dense system' semantically even if its own new axioms are disjoint from Dense's -- the DerivationTree at that class inherits/admits the lower class's axioms via the order relation, not via explicit axiom restatement. Worth checking this order (FormalSystem/ProofSystem/Axioms.lean's FrameClass LE instance) before assuming two frame-class systems are independent extensions of a common base.

docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md pins the external paper's definitions verbatim with sha256 checksums and explicitly marks retired/renamed anchors DANGLING with a pointer to the live replacement. When a typst-alignment task needs to know the paper's *current* wording/title/extends-relationship for a renamed system, this file is the authoritative, already-resolved source -- no need to treat the rename target as an open research question if this file already records it.
